title: Los Angeles Chargers could be down both starting tackles vs. the Broncos

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Los Angeles Chargers could be down both starting tackles vs. the Broncos
sources.description: The Broncos’ pass rush could have a boost this weekend. It was already reported earlier this week that the Chargers’ starting left tackle Rashawn Slater suffered a high ankle sprain this past Sunday and is expected to miss some time. Well, the bad news continued on Wednesday when NFL Network’s lead league insider Ian Rapoport […]
